_source.compiled: 2026-11-24, by hand, for case-law-explorer roadmap item R3.1
references: EUR-Lex: CELEX numbers of the founding, amending and accession treaties and of the Charter (https://eur-lex.europa.eu/collection/eu-law/treaties.html)
Council of Europe Treaty Office: full list of treaties, CETS numbers and dates of opening for signature (https://www.coe.int/en/web/conventions/full-list)
United Nations Treaty Collection: depositary chapters IV (human rights) and V (refugees and stateless persons), MTDSG numbers and dates of adoption (https://treaties.un.org)
_source.checked_online: On 2026-11-24 these were confirmed against the pages: CELEX 11997D (Treaty of Amsterdam); UN IV-2, IV-3, IV-8, IV-9, IV-11, IV-15, V-2, V-5 with their dates. EUR-Lex collection pages and the Council of Europe list refused automated fetches and UN IV-4 returned no content, so the other CELEX numbers, every CETS number and IV-4 were taken from the references above without that check. IV-2's date is the General Assembly adoption date (21 December 1965); the treaty page heads it with the opening for signature, 7 March 1966.
_source.conventions: scheme 'celex': CELEX number of the whole act (sector 1: sector, year and letter, e.g. 12016E); 'coe_treaty': CETS number, three digits; 'un_treaty': UN Treaty Collection MTDSG chapter-number. enacted_date is the date of signature or adoption where given, otherwise only enacted_year. Aliases go to the most recent consolidated version of a treaty (TFEU/TEU/Charter 2016, EC Treaty 2006). protocol_number is the ECHR protocol number used in HUDOC article codes (P1-1 = Protocol No. 1, article 1; 0 = the Convention).
_source.not_runtime: Committed reference data; no code path downloads it.
